issue.title: Stop registry-candidates from conflating unrelated key domains

implementation.change: Resolve mutation receiver identity from the lexical or imported root value plus its static member path. Shared imported registries still coalesce; unrelated parameters and local DOM instances remain distinct.

implementation.change: Normalize AST StringLiteral property names with getLiteralText before comparing dispatch sets.
Classify NumericLiteral and numeric StringLiteral keys structurally, then suppress numeric-only overlap only when both key-axis origins resolve and differ; unresolved primitive axes remain visible.
Resolve referenced contribution declarations inside typed or satisfies object/array compositions and suppress without-door only when one composition covers the complete sibling group.
